findingDetails.title: The refusal gate hardcodes a two-value loop-type pair instead of the file's own allowlist
findingDetails.scopeProof: fanout-run.cjs is a declared review-scope file and the guard is part of the child 003 change
findingDetails.case: A maintainer enables a third loop type by adding it to ACTIVE_FANOUT_LOOP_TYPES at .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs:475; an executor matrix that expands to one lineage for that type then spawns a single CLI process that runs every iteration in-process with no refusal, because the guard's literal pair never matches the new value.
findingDetails.reach: none at this revision; assertActiveFanoutLoopType at :3306 makes the pair equivalent to the set today, so the finding is hardening and stays below P1
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked whether any third loop type can reach the guard: ensureString plus assertActiveFanoutLoopType at :3305-3306 admit exactly research and review, so none can
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the duplication may be accepted style, since the same pair appears at :1114 and :3409 for the max-iterations policy
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: none available; severity is already the floor
findingDetails.claim: the guard's membership test duplicates the authoritative allowlist and would fail open if the allowlist widened
